# BuildVystra

> BuildVystra is a construction management SaaS platform to plan projects, track sites, and manage teams, materials and progress in real time. Available as a web app and mobile app. Built and operated by Vystra (https://vystra.in).

## Key facts
- Name: BuildVystra
- Website: https://build.vystra.in
- Category: Construction management software / project & site tracking SaaS
- Platforms: Web app, iOS, Android
- Maker: Vystra — digital product studio (https://vystra.in)
- Contact: admin@vystra.in · WhatsApp +91 90873 40087

## What it does
- Plan and organise construction projects
- Track sites and real-time progress
- Manage teams, workers, materials and tasks
- Dashboards and reporting for on-track visibility

## Links
- Product: https://build.vystra.in
